methodology: Million KZT. State non-oil budget deficit (surplus), STATE budget (republican + local government budgets combined) -- broader scope than NON_OIL_BUDGET_DEFICIT, which is republican-budget-only. Negative values indicate a deficit. 2019-2021: the bulletin's columns repeat the financing row, so these years are deficit - National Fund transfers - crude oil export duty (the identity every printed month satisfies).
